decision: NO_PROMOTION_IRRESPECTIVE_OF_RESULTS; requires unseen prospective formal validation

fixed_predeclared_role_model.prior: National winrate × course historical first-rate and optional racer×actual-course head backoff, training-only
fixed_predeclared_role_model.role_guarded: on hypothetical winner boat1 blend 0.25/0.15; boat2 0.18/0.10; boat3/4 0.10/0.05; boat5/6 PL
fixed_predeclared_role_model.role_head12: on hypothetical winner boat1 P2/P3 blend 0.30/0.15; boat2 0.20/0.10; other heads PL
fixed_predeclared_role_model.roles: Hypothetical head role from race-card frame only; no actual holdout course

historical_fold_not_fresh: All three folds are retrospective and historical results had been available to V147/V148 training; F3 test reused.
limitations: Pre-race race card input extraction timestamps are NOT independently verified; provenance risk remains.
The 2-course wall or current exhibition is not directly observed, only proxy features.
These candidates are evaluated on previously accessed retrospective folds; selection is exploratory and not a new independent success claim.
Training histories start 2025-11-01, not complete 1-year on early folds.
Historical race card nationality strength is treated as pre-race; no race-card scrape timestamps audited.
No automatic selection/promote based on repeated historical testing.
Conditional effect is course/frame proxy; no live 2-course wall/ST/BOATERS original exhibition integrated.
Always compare A-head, Top3, Top5 and Top10, not minimal ticket count.

v150_frozen_hypotheses.head_tail_base_cond: 1st-place racer head strength; 2nd/3rd pre-race base with small training-only conditional frequency shrinkage (mix=0.18/0.10)
v150_frozen_hypotheses.head_tail_baseline: Only 1st-place uses historical racer-course head adjustment; 2nd and 3rd use pre-race base strength
v150_frozen_hypotheses.head_tail_place: 1st-place racer head strength; 2nd/3rd pre-race base adjusted by training-only racer×actual-course respective placing rates; shrink=20 exponent=0.35
v150_frozen_hypotheses.scoring_policy: 120 permutations, no odds, no manual hole boost, no ticket-count target
v150_frozen_hypotheses.training: each fold strictly prior to holdout; no heldout course/result used as prediction feature

v151_frozen_hypotheses.diagnostics: For each model report predicted non-1 head count, false non-1 alarms, non-1 recall, non-1 precision and predicted head3/4 count
v151_frozen_hypotheses.feature_scope: Only national mean ST and reported motor/national 2-place rates from heldout race card; no result-day outcomes/actual entry/exhibition/odds
v151_frozen_hypotheses.frozen_no_tuning: No parameter grid search or best-model promotion against F1 F2 F3
v151_frozen_hypotheses.pre_head_multisignal: Require >=2 positive signs among available 2+; gain 1.05 and inside damping 0.20
v151_frozen_hypotheses.pre_head_pressure: In frames 2-4 require >=2 reported card signals; score non-1 using avg ST, motor 2-rate, national 2-rate vs frame1; fixed gain 1.5 and 1-boat inverse damping 0.38
v151_frozen_hypotheses.pre_head_pressure_cond: Same head pressure with V148 train-only conditional second/third; not a new scenario predictor
